# Cisco Meraki
> Cloud-managed networking and security platform for Wi-Fi, switching, routing, IoT, and secure access.

Cisco Meraki provides centralized, cloud-based management for enterprise networks, including wireless, switching, security appliances, SD-WAN, cameras, sensors, mobile device management, and APIs.

## Documentation
- [Documentation Home](https://documentation.meraki.com/): Main technical documentation portal for Meraki products, deployment, configuration, and troubleshooting.
- [Meraki Dashboard](https://documentation.meraki.com/General_Administration/Cross-Platform_Content/Meraki_Dashboard): Overview of the cloud management dashboard and common administrative workflows.
- [Wireless LAN](https://documentation.meraki.com/MR): Documentation for Meraki MR access points, SSIDs, RF profiles, and wireless operations.
- [Switching](https://documentation.meraki.com/MS): Documentation for Meraki MS switches, Layer 2/3 features, and switch management.
- [Security and SD-WAN](https://documentation.meraki.com/MX): Documentation for MX appliances, VPN, firewall, traffic shaping, and WAN features.
- [Smart Cameras](https://documentation.meraki.com/MV): Documentation for MV cameras, video retention, analytics, and camera administration.
- [Systems Manager](https://documentation.meraki.com/SM): Documentation for endpoint management, enrollment, policies, and device administration.
- [Sensors](https://documentation.meraki.com/MT): Documentation for MT sensors, alerts, telemetry, and environmental monitoring.

## API and Developer
- [Meraki Developer Hub](https://developer.cisco.com/meraki/): Central developer portal for APIs, automation resources, learning materials, and platform updates.
- [Dashboard API Overview](https://developer.cisco.com/meraki/api-v1/overview/): Introduction to the Meraki Dashboard API, authentication, versioning, and usage concepts.
- [API Reference](https://developer.cisco.com/meraki/api-v1/): Full REST API reference for organizations, networks, devices, policies, and monitoring.
- [API Early Access](https://developer.cisco.com/meraki/api-v1/#!early-access): Reference for early-access endpoints and preview API capabilities.
- [Python Library](https://developer.cisco.com/meraki/api-v1/python/): Official Python SDK information, examples, installation, and usage guidance.
- [Postman Collection](https://developer.cisco.com/meraki/api-v1/postman/): Postman resources for exploring and testing Meraki Dashboard API endpoints.
- [Webhooks](https://developer.cisco.com/meraki/webhooks/): Developer guidance for receiving Meraki alerts and event notifications via webhooks.
- [Developer Community](https://community.meraki.com/t5/Developers-APIs/bd-p/api): Community discussions focused on API usage, automation, and integrations.

## Product Documentation
- [Cellular Gateways](https://documentation.meraki.com/MG): Documentation for MG cellular gateways, uplink connectivity, and deployment guidance.
- [Secure Connect](https://documentation.meraki.com/CiscoPlusSecureConnect): Documentation for cloud-delivered secure access and remote connectivity features.
- [Insight](https://documentation.meraki.com/Insight): Documentation for Meraki Insight application performance and WAN health monitoring.
- [Trusted Access](https://documentation.meraki.com/Trusted_Access): Documentation for access control, identity-based policies, and secure onboarding workflows.
- [Meraki Go](https://documentation.meraki.com/Go): Documentation for Meraki Go small-business networking products and app-based management.
- [Licensing](https://documentation.meraki.com/General_Administration/Licensing): Documentation for co-termination, per-device licensing, and subscription management.
- [Firmware Features](https://documentation.meraki.com/Firmware_Features): Release-specific feature documentation across Meraki product families.

## Deployment and Administration Guides
- [General Administration](https://documentation.meraki.com/General_Administration): Administrative guidance for organizations, networks, permissions, and dashboard settings.
- [Cross-Platform Content](https://documentation.meraki.com/General_Administration/Cross-Platform_Content): Shared operational guidance that applies across multiple Meraki product lines.
- [Best Practices](https://documentation.meraki.com/Architectures_and_Best_Practices): Design recommendations, validated architectures, and deployment best practices.
- [Monitoring and Reporting](https://documentation.meraki.com/General_Administration/Monitoring_and_Reporting): Guidance for alerts, event logs, summaries, and operational visibility.
- [Alerts and Notifications](https://documentation.meraki.com/General_Administration/Cross-Platform_Content/Alerts_and_Notifications): Configuration details for dashboard alerts, thresholds, and notification delivery.
- [Organization Administration](https://documentation.meraki.com/General_Administration/Organizations_and_Networks): Guidance for managing organizations, networks, templates, and administrators.
- [Templates and Configuration Sync](https://documentation.meraki.com/General_Administration/Templates_and_Config_Sync): Documentation for template-based configuration management at scale.
- [Meraki Cloud Architecture](https://documentation.meraki.com/General_Administration/Other_Topics/Meraki_Cloud_Architecture): Technical overview of Meraki cloud architecture and management-plane behavior.

## Security, Identity, and Access
- [Adaptive Policy](https://documentation.meraki.com/General_Administration/Cross-Platform_Content/Adaptive_Policy): Documentation for identity-based segmentation and policy enforcement across the network.
- [Site-to-Site VPN](https://documentation.meraki.com/MX/Site-to-site_VPN): Configuration and operational guidance for Auto VPN and site-to-site connectivity.
- [Client VPN](https://documentation.meraki.com/MX/Client_VPN): Documentation for remote user VPN setup, authentication, and troubleshooting.
- [Firewall and Traffic Shaping](https://documentation.meraki.com/MX/Firewall_and_Traffic_Shaping): Guidance for firewall rules, content filtering, and traffic control policies.
- [802.1X Authentication](https://documentation.meraki.com/MR/Encryption_and_Authentication): Wireless authentication guidance including WPA-Enterprise and 802.1X.
- [Trusted Access Overview](https://documentation.meraki.com/Trusted_Access/Trusted_Access_Overview): Overview of secure onboarding and identity-aware access capabilities.
- [Secure SD-WAN](https://documentation.meraki.com/MX/SD-WAN_and_Traffic_Shaping): Documentation for WAN policy, path selection, and application-aware routing.

- [Meraki Community](https://community.meraki.com/): User community for technical discussions, announcements, and peer support.
- [Webinars and Events](https://community.meraki.com/t5/Community-Webinars/bd-p/community-webinars): Recorded and upcoming webinars covering products, features, and deployment guidance.

- [Event Log](https://documentation.meraki.com/General_Administration/Monitoring_and_Reporting/Event_Log): Guidance for using event logs to investigate network behavior.
